title: Great experience!!!
text: We book this tour only one hour ahead with no problem at all. The meeting place was easy to locate, especially when compared to other groups that have to guess who their guide is in a very crowded area. Play Granada has an actual store front. Our group was only four of us, and our guide Lautaro. He took us to the same classic sites in Albaicin and Sacromonte but following less crowded streets so we could get the local feel. He was very knowledgeable and charming making the long walk truly enjoyable. We definitely recommend !!!!
author: ecifuen1

title: Spanish-language guide through Granada, incredible!
text: Guided walking tour of Granada in Spanish, it was great, Lautaro our guide is very knowledgeable about the subject, he was very kind, and he gave us many details that made the experience incredible, highly recommended!

author: Diego_D

title: A lovely tour in the Albaicín
text: Andrea is an enthusiastic, engaging, and fun young guide which clearly shines through in her passion for Andalusian culture, art, and nature, and the tour through the Albaicín, the Sacromonte Abbey, and the cave houses, enhanced by stunning views of the Alhambra, was especially enjoyable and definitely worth seeing. Grazie

title: A wonderful breath taking walk
text: Marta as our Tour Guide was the best Guide ever. Very competent, eloquent, very well  prepared, tramendous background knowledge, charming, polite, gentle. We enjoyed These two hours so much and are inspired to discover more places around Granada. Thanks to Marta!
author: OnAir43485534426

title: Excellent tour with Marta!
text: We had originally planned to visit the Alhambra but every monument and museum was closed due to inclement weather so we ended up taking a private walking tour of Albayzin and Sacromonte. Marta was an excellent guide—so knowledgeable and charming—and we had such a great time despite the weather! She even gave us some great recommendations for tapas in Granada. I cannot recommend taking a tour with Marta highly enough—we love her!!
author: 459genevac
